sentences.en: He who is afraid of asking is ashamed of learning.
sentences.zh: 不敢提问的人是为学习而羞愧。

sentences.en: Later Chris felt ashamed and apologized, and Beth forgave him.
sentences.zh: 后来克里斯感到惭愧并道歉了，贝丝原谅了他。

sentences.en: I am ashamed of not having been kind to her.
sentences.zh: 我为自己对她不够好而感到羞耻。

senses.zh: 羞愧的，羞耻的；惭愧的，内疚的；尴尬的；因怕难堪而不愿意的；觉得丢脸的
